mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Profile (user_id, preferred_name, pronouns, email, introduction, avatar, school_name, graduation_year, major, interest, profile, date_of_birth) VALUES (#{userId}, #{preferredName}, #{pronouns}, #{email}, #{introduction}, #{avatar}, #{schoolName}, #{graduationYear}, #{major}, #{interest}, #{profile}, #{dateOfBirth})
mapper.update: UPDATE Profile SET preferred_name = #{preferredName}, pronouns = #{pronouns}, introduction = #{introduction}, avatar = #{avatar}, school_name = #{schoolName}, graduation_year = #{graduationYear}, major = #{major}, interest = #{interest}, profile = #{profile}, email = #{email}, date_of_birth = #{dateOfBirth} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT p.*, CASE WHEN COUNT(l.user_id) > 0 THEN CAST(GROUP_CONCAT(c.name) AS CHAR) ELSE NULL END AS completed_courses FROM Profile p LEFT JOIN Learn l ON p.user_id = l.user_id AND (l.course_status = "completed") LEFT JOIN Course c ON l.course_id = c.id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY p.user_id, p.id, p.preferred_name, p.pronouns, p.email, p.introduction, p.avatar, p.school_name, p.graduation_year, p.major, p.interest, p.profile, p.privacy;
